old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of two wooden planks placed on a metal track system. The planks are secured by blue clamps at regular intervals along their lengths. A pair of hands appears in the frame, gesturing towards the planks and clamps, possibly explaining or demonstrating something about the setup. The background is a plain white wall, and the metal track system is mounted on a black frame, suggesting an industrial or workshop setting. The hands move slightly, indicating an interaction with the setup, but no significant changes occur to the objects themselves during the sequence. The focus remains on the wooden planks and the clamps, highlighting the precision and stability of the setup.

caption: The video showcases a linear-motion test rig viewed from a high angle: two fixed wooden beams each carry a polished metal rod, and four blue bearing blocks tied to two wooden boards form a sliding carriage against a black frame with red knobs. The carriage drifts rightward along the rods to a rightmost position near the middle of the excerpt, then reverses and slides leftward to a leftmost rest position, then begins moving rightward. A left hand, its index finger extended, touches the near-left block at the start and withdraws, while a right hand enters from the lower right and rests on the near-right block. The left hand re-enters and hovers at the near-left block. The beams, rods and background frame stay stationary, so the change is object motion, not camera motion.
